quizName:
Hardest Questions in Oklahoma
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What should you do before turning?
questions.explanation: Always turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This tells other drivers what you plan to do.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel tired while driving?

options.text: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.
questions.explanation: Take breaks every hour during long trips. If possible, share driving with another person so you can sleep while they drive.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle with sirens and flashing lights approaches, should you pull to the right side of the road and let it pass?
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with lights and sirens, move to the right side of the road right away and let it pass.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, what must you do?

options.text: Always signal, even if you don't see any other cars.
Signal only if other cars are nearby.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if you don't see any other cars.
questions.explanation: Always use your signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from a curb. Make this a habit every time.

questions.question: You are angry after a bad day at work. What should you do before you drive home?

options.text: Play loud music to stop thinking about it.
Drive fast on the highway to release anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down first.
Have drinks at a bar before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down first.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait until you feel calm before driving. Driving while emotional is dangerous for you and others on the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for traffic control signs in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: Like alcohol and other drugs, drowsiness can:
questions.explanation: Lack of sleep causes poor driving. Like drugs and alcohol, tiredness slows your reaction time, reduces awareness, and weakens judgment.

questions.question: Who must wear a seat belt?
questions.explanation: Oklahoma law requires all front seat occupants to wear a seat belt. Children under 13 must wear a seat belt in any seat.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: If a truck or bus is turning right where you also need to turn right, you should:

options.text: Quickly turn before the truck or bus.
Wait until the truck or bus finishes its turn.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus finishes its turn.
questions.explanation: Do not try to fit your car between a turning truck or bus and the curb. You could crash. Wait until the truck or bus completes its turn before you turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers that bicycles, animals, or people may cross the road.

questions.question: In a vehicle with airbags, where should children age 12 and under sit?

options.text: The bed of a pick-up truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags can hurt children. Anyone age 12 or under should sit in the back seat of a vehicle with airbags.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is prohibited. You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When approaching railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate comes down.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Not worry about how many tracks to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When you see railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you?
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, reduces your vision, and makes it hard to judge distance. All of these effects make driving dangerous.
